import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

source = Path('products/services/direct-buyer-data-qa/raw/tender-feed.json')
output = source.parent.parent / 'feed-shortlist-nov20.json'
cutoff = dt.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-20T21:55:11+00:00')
terms = re.compile(r'data (?:quality|cleans(?:ing|e)|cleaning|conversion|validation|reconciliation|migration)|(?:spreadsheet|csv|dataset|database) (?:audit|conversion|validation|reconciliation)|record linkage', re.I)
report = {'source': str(source), 'source_url': 'https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/', 'cutoff_utc': cutoff.isoformat(), 'coverage': 'One saved feed capture. Candidates require original-notice verification. Feed matches do not establish standalone scope, eligibility or a current response route.'}
try:
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    report['source_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    releases = json.loads(raw).get('releases')
    if not isinstance(releases, list):
        raise ValueError('Missing OCDS releases array')
    report['release_count'] = len(releases)
    candidates = {}
    for release in releases:
        tender = release.get('tender') or {}
        if tender.get('status') != 'active' or 'tender' not in release.get('tag', []):
            continue
        end = (tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate')
        try:
            deadline = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(end.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            if deadline <= cutoff:
                continue
        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        title = str(tender.get('title') or '')
        description = str(tender.get('description') or '')
        matches = sorted({match.group(0).lower() for match in terms.finditer(title + '\n' + description)})
        notice = str(release.get('id') or '')
        if not matches or not re.fullmatch(r'\d{6}-\d{4}', notice):
            continue
        rank = (bool(terms.search(title)), len(matches), deadline, notice)
        candidates[notice] = (rank, {'notice_id': notice, 'ocid': release.get('ocid'), 'title': title, 'deadline': end, 'matched_terms': matches, 'original_notice_url': 'https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/' + notice})
    report['matching_notice_count'] = len(candidates)
    report['shortlist'] = [item[1] for item in sorted(candidates.values(), key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)[:2]]
except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError) as error:
    report['feed_error'] = str(error)
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
